outcome: Two real nonsingular skew-symmetric 6-by-6 forms, neither scalar J, have all three source Pfaffian invariants equal but belong to different symplectic congruence orbits.
priority: Formal verification of Shivam Patel’s posted 6-by-6 counterexample; no discovery or first-formalization claim.
source_correction: The primary source defines S(2n,R) as nonsingular skew-symmetric matrices. MathDB’s word symmetric is a transcription error; target is the actual symplectic-form conjecture.
title: Insufficiency of Pfaffian invariants for symplectic congruence
